title: AI-chain market events — 2026-11-13
body:
**Just landed (2026-11-12, pre-open 07:30 ET / 13:30 CET):** Nebius (NBIS) Q3 — revenue beat at $980.8M (+571% y/y vs ~$907.5M consensus) and GAAP operating income turned positive (~$50M), but FY2026 revenue is guided to the low end of $3.0–3.4B and 2027 capex was raised to $40–45B vs ~$29B expected. NBIS fell ~17–20% on Nov 12; CoreWeave (−8% to −14%), IREN (−8%) and the neocloud complex sold off with it.

**Chain read-through:** the market is punishing capex intensity, not demand — customer prepayments still covered >100% of Nebius's Q3 contract capex and 75–85% of 2027 buildout. Neocloud stress favors the infrastructure sleeve (power/utilities, Vertiv-type physical bottleneck names) over levered compute lessors; the semis sleeve faces its real test **Tuesday Nov 17: Nvidia Q3, post-close 16:20 ET / 22:20 CET** (~$108.8B revenue consensus, options implying ~11% move). Cash sleeve: hold the defensive 15% with a December hike ~89% priced.
